users_has_sign_in_identifier.name: users_has_sign_in_identifier
users_has_sign_in_identifier.value: "users"."email" is not null or "users"."phone" is not null

skus_pack_size_union.name: skus_pack_size_union

attendance_sessions_check_in_evidence.name: attendance_sessions_check_in_evidence
attendance_sessions_check_in_evidence.value:
"attendance_sessions"."opened_on_behalf_by" is not null or (
      "attendance_sessions"."check_in_selfie_id" is not null and "attendance_sessions"."check_in_lat" is not null and "attendance_sessions"."check_in_lng" is not null)

attendance_sessions_check_out_evidence.name: attendance_sessions_check_out_evidence
attendance_sessions_check_out_evidence.value:
"attendance_sessions"."checked_out_at" is null or (
      "attendance_sessions"."check_out_selfie_id" is not null and "attendance_sessions"."check_out_lat" is not null and "attendance_sessions"."check_out_lng" is not null)

stock_movements_account_scope.name: stock_movements_account_scope

cash_ledger_sign.name: cash_ledger_sign
cash_ledger_sign.value: ("cash_ledger_entries"."entry_type" = 'COLLECTION' and "cash_ledger_entries"."amount" > 0) or ("cash_ledger_entries"."entry_type" = 'DISCREPANCY' and "cash_ledger_entries"."amount" <> 0) or ("cash_ledger_entries"."entry_type" not in ('COLLECTION', 'DISCREPANCY') and "cash_ledger_entries"."amount" < 0)

delivery_documents_ready.name: delivery_documents_ready
delivery_documents_ready.value: ("delivery_documents"."status" = 'READY') = ("delivery_documents"."storage_key" is not null and "delivery_documents"."rendered_at" is not null)

discount_approval_requests_decided.name: discount_approval_requests_decided
discount_approval_requests_decided.value: ("discount_approval_requests"."status" in ('APPROVED', 'REDUCED', 'REJECTED')) = ("discount_approval_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "discount_approval_requests"."decided_by" is not null)

sales_completed.name: sales_completed
sales_completed.value: ("sales"."status" = 'COMPLETED') = ("sales"."completed_at" is not null and "sales"."ledger_entry_id" is not null)

sales_cancelled.name: sales_cancelled
sales_cancelled.value: ("sales"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("sales"."cancelled_at" is not null and "sales"."cancel_reason" is not null)

dispatch_order_lines_receipt.name: dispatch_order_lines_receipt
dispatch_order_lines_receipt.value:
("dispatch_order_lines"."received_packs" is null and "dispatch_order_lines"."short_packs" is null and "dispatch_order_lines"."damaged_packs" is null)
      or ("dispatch_order_lines"."received_packs" >= 0 and "dispatch_order_lines"."short_packs" >= 0 and "dispatch_order_lines"."damaged_packs" >= 0 and "dispatch_order_lines"."received_packs" + "dispatch_order_lines"."short_packs" + "dispatch_order_lines"."damaged_packs" = "dispatch_order_lines"."packs")

dispatch_orders_released.name: dispatch_orders_released
dispatch_orders_released.value: ("dispatch_orders"."status" in ('RELEASED', 'DELIVERED') or "dispatch_orders"."close_reason" in ('DELIVERED', 'LOST')) = ("dispatch_orders"."released_at" is not null and "dispatch_orders"."transport_slip_media_id" is not null)

dispatch_orders_confirmed.name: dispatch_orders_confirmed
dispatch_orders_confirmed.value: ("dispatch_orders"."confirmed_at" is not null) = ("dispatch_orders"."confirmation_mode" is not null)

dispatch_orders_closed.name: dispatch_orders_closed
dispatch_orders_closed.value: ("dispatch_orders"."status" = 'CLOSED') = ("dispatch_orders"."closed_at" is not null and "dispatch_orders"."close_reason" is not null)

returns_kind.name: returns_kind
returns_kind.value: ("returns"."kind" = 'CREDIT_NOTE' and "returns"."amount" > 0) or ("returns"."kind" = 'REPLACEMENT' and "returns"."amount" = 0 and "returns"."condition" = 'DEFECTIVE' and "returns"."vehicle_id" is not null)
